_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Wònye Golf (Kadi Nyagblɔɖe) - Nyɔnu {player_id}.
Ɖo: Xɔ akpɔkpɔtɔwo viviwo le dzidzim siwo. Ekpɔm be dzesiwo xɔ dzidzim siwo, wozu 0.
Kadi dzesiwo: A=1, 2-10=dzesiwo ƒe xexlẽ, J/Q=10, K=0

Kpɔkpɔtɔwo (xɔ kpɔkpɔtɔwo ƒe akpa):
- '[draw]' - Xɔ kadi tso kadi dzesiwo
- '[take]' - Xɔ kadi tso kadi nyagblɔɖe ƒe dzidzim
- '[swap X Y]' - Xɔ kadi siwo wozu kadi nyagblɔɖe me tso dzidzim X (dzidzim) Y (xexlẽ)
- '[discard]' - Xɔ kadi siwo wozu kadi nyagblɔɖe me tso

board.drew:
Efe kpe: {card}
Nye efe na [swap X Y] yi ɖe [discard]
board.took:
Wòxɔ kadi: {card} tso kadi nyagblɔɖe ƒe dzidzim
Wò kpɔm [swap X Y] e (me kpɔm xɔ kadi tso).

options.final_turns: Ŋkɔ ɖe ɖo alɔ! Nyaŋu ŋuti: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Ele be: [swap X Y] (woagate ŋu aɖe ka siwo le wo nɔewo dome ɖa o)
options.swap_or_discard: Efe na wɔna: [swap X Y] ɖi le [discard]

action_desc.swapped: Dɔwɔla {pid} wɔ kpɔ {new} dzi le {old} le pozisi ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Ʋua megale ame aɖeke si o! Fefe la wu enu enumake.
message.knocked: Ðela {pid} dze anyi! Egblẽa gome ɖeka na eƒola bubuwo.
message.final_round: Akalaka {pid} {reason}! Kalaka ɖeka katso ƒe akalaka bubu ge ɖe asi ɖeka.

invalid.wrong_action: Le yi ŋkɔ ŋuti: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], ɖi le [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Nu siwo wotsɔ ƒu gbe la vɔ!
invalid.must_draw_first: Efe na wɔna [draw], [take], [knock], ɖi le [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Màte ŋu aɖe ka si woɖe le agba siwo wotsɔ ƒu gbe la me o. Ele be nàtsɔe atrɔe boŋ.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Efe wɔ kpe. Efe na [swap X Y] yi ɖe [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Àhiã be woada ka na wò hafi nàte ŋu adzra.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Àhiã be woade dzesi wò hafi nàɖe asi le eŋu.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Pozisi ɖe ɖo alɔ. Le ŋkɔ 1-{max_row}, kɔlɔm 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Màte ŋu atsɔ agbalẽ si wotsɔ ɖe asi la aƒoe o. Wɔ wò mɔɖeɖedɔa vɔ gbã.
invalid.already_knocked: Ame aɖe ƒo ƒu kpɔ le ho sia me xoxo.
